article_summaries.title: Trading Card Game - Free Realms Forums
article_summaries.summary: This is a captured thread-index page for the Trading Card Game forum on the Free Realms fan forum, from late May 2009. It lists thread titles, reply counts and last-post dates but no post content. It gives little rebuild-usable detail, beyond showing that players were discussing the in-game Trading Card Game, its quest series, and whether physical cards were available in the EU.
